name: Studio 75
description: A 75% mechanical keyboard with three-mode wireless freedom and a comfortable, balanced feel.
longDescription: The Studio 75 pairs a 75% layout with a machined aluminum case and durable PBT keycaps. A gasket-mounted plate softens the bottom-out feel, while hot-swappable sockets make it easy to try a different switch. Choose linear switches for a smooth press, tactile switches for a gentle bump, or clicky switches for audible feedback. USB-C, Bluetooth, and 2.4 GHz connections let you move between your desk and laptop.
